title.value: Learning Graph Weighted Models on Pictures
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned at the very beginning of the paper.
title.quote: # Learning Graph Weighted Models on Pictures

analysis.description: This paper explores Graph Weighted Models (GWMs), which generalize weighted automata over strings and trees to arbitrary families of labeled graphs, specifically focusing on regression and classification tasks in picture languages. The study investigates learning GWMs using gradient-based methods through experiments on 'Bars & Stripes' and 'Shifting Bits' picture languages, indicating that GWMs can be learned from both positive and negative examples in these contexts.

type.justification: The paper conducts experimental studies to explore learning GWMs using gradient-based methods on picture data, providing empirical evidence.
type.quote: In this paper, we consider the problem of learning GWMs defined over the graph family of pictures (or 2-dimensional words). As a proof of concept, we consider regression and classification tasks... and provide an experimental study...

name.justification: The research primarily revolves around Graph Weighted Models, which are a generalization of weighted automata for labeled graphs.
name.quote: Graph Weighted Models (GWMs) have recently been proposed as a natural generalization of weighted automata over strings and trees to arbitrary families of labeled graphs (and hypergraphs).

name.justification: The paper focuses on learning tasks involving 'Bars & Stripes' and 'Shifting Bits' picture languages using GWMs.
name.quote: Firstly, as an instance of regression tasks, we examine the Bars & Stripes language made of pictures containing only horizontal or vertical stripes.

name.justification: GWMs associate labeled graphs with tensor networks, which compute values through successive contractions, a fundamental concept explored in the paper.
name.quote: A GWM generically associates a labeled graph with a tensor network and computes a value by successive contractions directed by its edges.

name.justification: Graph Weighted Models are a central focus of the paper and are applied to learning tasks with tensor networks over pictures.
name.quote: Graph Weighted Models (GWMs) have recently been proposed as a natural generalization of weighted automata over strings and trees to arbitrary families of labeled graphs (and hypergraphs).
